description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for managing 'Note' entities within a Room database in an Android application. It provides methods for CRUD operations and search functionality targeting notes data.

classes.name: NoteDao
classes.description: DAO interface providing CRUD and search operations for notes in the database.

methods.name: observeAll
methods.description: Returns a Flow that emits a list of all notes ordered by 'updatedAt' descending.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Suspending function that retrieves a Note by its ID.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Suspending function that inserts or replaces a note, returning its row ID.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Suspending function that deletes a note by its ID.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Returns a Flow that emits a list of notes matching the search query in title or content.
